<span id="before-starting-the-qc"></span>

<!-- qc-source-start -->
Find the `reports/` folder in your HALFpipe working directory after [checking that processing completed](../check_run.qmd). You'll use these files during QC.

| File | What you use it for |
|---|---|
| `reportpreproc.txt` | Check which outputs are marked `done` or `missing`. |
| `index.html` | Open the browser report to inspect images and record ratings. |
| `reportvals.txt` | Look up numerical QC measures, such as mean framewise displacement (FD) and mean grey matter temporal signal-to-noise ratio (tSNR). |

::: {.callout-tip title="Reviewing on another computer"}
Copy the entire `reports/` folder, including the subject folders and supporting files. The browser report needs those files to display its images.
:::

Next, [open the summary report](summary-report.qmd).
<!-- qc-source-end -->
